workarounds.symptom: `wrangler d1 migrations list --remote` ignores `account_id` from the config file
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [wrangler] Use config account_id in d1 migrations list --remote. Target files: packages/wrangler/src/d1/migrations/list.ts, packages/wrangler/src/__tests__/d1/migrate.test.ts, .changeset/d1-migrations-list-account-id.md. `wrangler d1 migrations list --remote` ignored the `account_id` in the Wrangler configuration file. If your login can see more than one account, the command failed in non-interactive mode. In interactive mode, it asked you to select an account. (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16688)

workarounds.symptom: wrangler delete leaves the Containers application running and billing

Target files: packages/wrangler/src/containers/worker-applications.ts, packages/wrangler/src/delete.ts, packages/wrangler/src/__tests__/delete.test.ts. `wrangler deploy` creates a Containers application for every Durable Object-backed Container, but `wrangler delete` removed only the Worker: (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16011)

workarounds.symptom: [vite-plugin] server.ws: false leaves Vite HMR WebSocket upgrades hanging
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [vite-plugin] Close disabled HMR WebSocket upgrades. Target files: packages/vite-plugin-cloudflare/src/plugins/dev.ts, packages/vite-plugin-cloudflare/src/websockets.ts, packages/vite-plugin-cloudflare/src/__tests__/websockets.spec.ts. Close Vite HMR upgrade sockets when `server.ws` is disabled and no Vite WebSocket handler can claim them. Continue delegating requests to Vite when enabled, while preserving Worker and Sandbox WebSocket forwarding. (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/15290)

workarounds.symptom: vite-plugin-cloudflare: dev server destroys WebSockets that don't announce a "vite" subprotocol

Node dispatches `upgrade` to every registered listener. The dev-server handler forwarded the request to the Worker, then destroyed the raw socket when the Worker returned no route — even if another listener (for example Vite DevTools at `/__devtools/__ws`) had already completed t... (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/15659)

workarounds.symptom: vite-plugin: second createServer in one process fails after worker exports change
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [vite-plugin] Clear Worker export types when the dev server closes. The plugin caches each Worker's export types in module-level state so that Vite restarts can reuse them. Nothing cleared that cache on `server.close()`, so a dev server created later in the same process built its Worker entry from the previous server's exports. That e... (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16457)

workarounds.symptom: [wrangler] `kv key list` in local mode returns only the first 1000 keys, with no warning
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [wrangler] Fix kv key list returning only the first 1000 keys in local mode. Target files: packages/wrangler/src/kv/index.ts, packages/wrangler/src/__tests__/kv/local.test.ts, .changeset/kv-key-list-local-pagination.md. I noticed that `wrangler kv key list` stops at 1000 keys when it reads local storage, which is the default mode now. I put 1500 keys into a local namespace with `kv bulk put` and the list came back with exactly 1000, ending at `k0999`, with nothing to say that anything was missing. `kv key get k1499` ... (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16405)

workarounds.symptom: `wrangler auth token --json` prints nothing when `WRANGLER_LOG` is `warn`/`error`/`none`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [wrangler] Print `auth token --json` output regardless of WRANGLER_LOG. Target files: packages/wrangler/src/user/commands.ts, packages/wrangler/src/__tests__/user.test.ts, .changeset/auth-token-json-log-level.md. `wrangler auth token --json` printed its JSON through `logger.log`, so with `WRANGLER_LOG=warn|error|none` it exited 0 with empty stdout. This switches it to `logger.json()`, which other `--json` commands already use and which isn't filtered by log level. Also hit by opennextjs/opennextjs-cloudflare#1278. (Ref: https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16388)
